title: Double T
description: Double T is a 1.20.1 Forge modpack for YouTubers who don't want to deal with mod setup. Furniture, guns, explosives, vehicles, security, and performance mods — all ready. Just install and record.
body: Double T is a 1.20.1 Forge modpack built specifically for YouTubers and content creators who don't want to waste hours hunting down mods and fixing compatibility issues. Just install it and jump straight into recording — everything is already set up for you. The pack comes loaded with furniture mods for building cool bases, guns and explosives for action-packed content, vehicles for exploration, security mods to protect your builds, and performance mods to keep things running smooth. Whether you're making a survival series, a war video, or just messing around with friends, Double A has you covered. Currently in beta, so expect regular updates and improvements.
